timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Herasus is a centre of global dialogue working towards a sustainable future.
We bring together select representatives from over 70 countries to explore, define and
implement sustainable solutions to the most pressing issues concerning today's corporations
and societies, including economic growth, innovation, migration and inequality.
We aim to facilitate cooperation and knowledge sharing between developed and emerging markets,
with the goal of leading collaborative sustainable growth for corporations and governments worldwide.
Our professional guidance to corporate leaders is based on three fundamental values, sustainability,
entrepreneurship, and community building.
I think the kind of people that attend this event are those who are leaders in their own right.
They have led by way of innovation, by way of business models, by way of their contribution
significantly to their respective sectors and their harbour of vision.
I believe that many of our leaders are not playing according to the rules anymore,
thinking about trade, thinking about protectionism.
At our meeting, we would like to bring everybody back.
We need a multilateral level, we have to join hands, we have to join the inspire the future.
Africa is the continent of the future.
We have a lot of resources in Africa.
We can do a lot of things in Africa.
But the first decision is our decision.
You need to take, you need to keep our destiny.
We want to have these children, these orphans, so they can communicate via computer
and exchange, education, language training, computer skills.
And maybe in ten or fifteen years working one of our companies.
But look, education now, because if you find, if you find education now,
you see the results in ten, twenty, thirty years.
I believe that women are going to play an absolutely pivotal role in taking our societies
in our world to the next level of innovation and prosperity.
We need to be the leaders of the world in economy, in climate, in peace, in cooperation.
And therefore we need Europe more than ever.
The Horacis events bring together highly influential groups of business leaders
to discuss collaborative approaches to addressing sustainable growth.
The meetings are the foremost annual gatherings of business leaders
from emerging markets and their global counterparts.
The events are open to the chief executive officers of the world's leading companies,
serving as a platform to do business, engage with new markets, and make high profile connections.
The meetings are supported by knowledge partners, selected companies that contribute their expertise
and resources to Horacis.
Horacis Global Meeting, the community's flagship event, takes place each year in cascades.
The resort city just outside of Lisbon, Portugal.
Horacis also hosts regional summits, focusing on China, India, and Southeast Asia,
which take place yearly in rotating hosted cities.
